[NFCT.1.4.5] **`ds_identity_role_t` mirrors `proto/slot.proto#IdentityRole`.**
It must carry the same members at the same values, `DS_IDENTITY_` for
`IDENTITY_ROLE_`, `UNSPECIFIED` at zero included ([STYL.5.9.7]), so the role an
integrator declares and the role an artefact carries ([RDSC.5.5.7]) are one
vocabulary.
